Morning view of Kukenan and Roraima tepuis, from Tëk river camp (river visible in the image), in Gran Sabana, Venezuela. Roraima tepui is actually some 100 mts higher than Kukenan, but due to the perspective of the picture, it looks like it is lower.
Kukenan Tepuy in Gran Sabana National Park, Venezuela. Photo taken from Tëk River Camp at 5:20 p.m. Tepuy height: 2700-2800 mts.
Highest point of Mount Roraima in the Venezuelan side
